title: OrganizerAttentionScheduleDocument
description: Server-owned evaluation record for one organizer's Host Today attention queue: when the evaluator last committed, when the five-minute sweep must evaluate it again, and whether that evaluation read every source completely. Managers read it beside the open organizerAttentionItems rows; a queue whose schedule is missing or incomplete is never a complete all-clear. evaluatedAt is when the last evaluation committed; nextEvaluationAt is when an item can next become due, change urgency or expire with no source write (null when nothing can change with time).
x-owner: Host Today attention evaluator (hostReadModels attention triggers and sweepOrganizerAttention)

revision.description: Increases by one with every committed evaluation.

sourceCoverage.description: Whether the last evaluation read every source completely. overCap (a source over its cap) and invalidSource (a loaded source row failed validation) both leave the items as they were.

incompleteSource.description: The source behind an incomplete evaluation: for overCap, the collection that exceeded the 400-row cap (organizerAttentionItems for the open rows, derivedItems for the derived queue), or mutations when one evaluation would write more than 450 rows; for invalidSource, the collection whose row failed validation. Null when coverage is complete.

openItemCount.description: Open rows after the evaluation. After an incomplete evaluation it is the number of open rows read, at most 401.
